name: build-goals
description: A focused toolkit for clarifying goals and building verifiable Agent Skills, plugins, product PRDs, and GitHub READMEs.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify goals and build Skills, plugins, PRDs, and READMEs
interface.longDescription: A focused toolkit that turns clarified goals and repository facts into designed, implemented, validated, and deliverable Agent Skills, Claude Code or Codex plugins, product requirements documents, and GitHub READMEs.
defaultPrompt: Use shape-idea to turn a rough idea into a clear scope with fully resolved decisions.
Use build-skill or build-plugin to create a verifiable Agent capability.
Use build-readme to explore a repository and create or update its GitHub README after a confirmed preview.
Use build-prd to turn an existing product or early idea into a research-backed, fully decided PRD, or handoff to prepare the next session.
